notes.title: Demo version update and bug fix
notes.notes:
Demo version update and bug fix guide



Errors found after the BIC exhibition, puzzle-related play convenience, and additional icons have been made.



Sound and directional updates are scheduled, and we are planning to get it done as soon as possible. I hope the demo version looks the best from scratch, but I don't think so.



But I'm going to do my best to get closer to him. Bye!



_ tinynap

notes.title: The demo version is now officially released!
notes.notes:
The demo of The Nobody Woods: Lucy is now officially available.
We apologize for the delay beyond the planned release date, as the review process took longer than expected.
Enjoy playing – updates will be released from time to time.
We’ll be back soon with more news! ^^

notes.title: Demo Version Release Notice!!
notes.notes:
Hello! The demo for The Nobody Woods: Lucy is still under review.
Due to scheduling issues, we had announced the demo release date in advance — but didn’t anticipate that the review process would still be ongoing 😢
We’ll release it as soon as it’s complete.

Also!!! The Nobody Woods: Lucy is making its first appearance at the Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC) in South Korea!
Both online and offline exhibitions are happening, and the online exhibition is now live!

See you soon! ^^
